title: The mainframe rejects September's claims extract
scenario: In the JDK 8 vs JDK 21 parallel run, August and October extracts are byte-identical and accepted, but the mainframe rejects every September record with a length error. The pod suspects the UTF-8 default charset or a tzdata update; go/no-go for the cutover is Monday.
task: Find the byte-level difference and the JDK change behind it
Rule the charset and tzdata theories in or out
Make the file contract independent of locale data and fail fast on overflow
Write the blast radius for the rest of the monolith and a go/no-go call
acceptance: All twelve months use the copybook abbreviations; 45-byte records; default locale irrelevant
JDK 21 output byte-identical to JDK 8 production for all three months
ANSWER.md names JEP 252 / CLDR with evidence and covers blast radius
